issues.where: crops C and E, upper-right bands and mid-disk
issues.what: at native size the cloud deck is stretched airbrushed paint; filaments are gone and the bands read as a smeared map
issues.fix: add a higher-frequency turbulence layer and cut the directional smear so the close view keeps filament detail

issues.where: crops L and R, upper deck and the disk right of the storm
issues.what: same soft paint: parallel streaks with no cross-flow, and the right flank is nearly featureless
issues.fix: bring those regions up to the storm's spatial frequency instead of a blurred base texture

issues.what: the vortex has structure, but the white arms are soft and the highlights are flat white
issues.fix: keep internal filament contrast in the bright clouds and soften only the outer falloff

issues.where: crop I, crescent moon on the right edge
issues.what: the lit limb stair-steps against space
issues.fix: antialias the moon silhouette so the curve has partial-coverage pixels

issues.where: crop L, moon at lower right
issues.what: the crescent is flat, and the dark limb reads as a faint cutout
issues.fix: add crater shading on the lit face and fade the unlit edge into the sky

issues.what: the rim is blown to a thin white line and eats the cloud detail under it
issues.fix: lower the limb exposure so the glow is a falloff and the bands stay readable inside it

issues.where: Q and R, center and right side of the globe below the terminator
issues.what: The cloud texture stretches into nearly parallel streaks and then dissolves into a smooth blue wash. The globe reads as a painted surface at native size.
issues.fix: Reduce directional stretching and preserve fine cloud structure through the terminator, letting the light fade without blurring the texture.

issues.where: A, E and I, cyan surface immediately below the horizon
issues.what: Most cloud detail compresses into long, soft bands parallel to the limb, with little variation in scale or direction. The sharper wisps farther down make the smeared band more conspicuous.
issues.fix: Break up the parallel bands with finer cloud structure and vary the scale and direction of the detail across the visible surface.

issues.where: Upper middle of the globe, bright hook-shaped cloud against the terminator
issues.what: The chalk-white fragments have hard edges and look pasted on against the much softer surrounding clouds.
issues.fix: Soften the fragment edges, add faint connecting wisps, and carry the local lighting falloff through the bright cloud.

issues.where: C, F and H, brighter ring edges and their right-hand ends
issues.what: Paired bright lines make parts of the ring look like an outlined rail, and the outermost line ends in a conspicuous bright tip in the limb glow.
issues.fix: Vary the opacity across the ring edges, reduce the paired highlights, and fade the ends into the atmospheric scattering.

issues.where: T and U, dense star field beside the shadowed globe
issues.what: Several brighter stars read as soft round dots with heavy halos rather than compact points.
issues.fix: Tighten the star cores and reserve stronger bloom for the very brightest stars.
